item: OSM: the geography view's changed count is stored in the places summary (RULE_REVISION 2), read in milliseconds instead of joined on every request
summary: Before: after R439 the geography view still joined the tag-change rows to the country's places on every read (4.6 s warm, 21.8 s on a cold cache, per country, at 2.0M places and 1.8M change rows); the freshness history read measured beside it was the planet-prior computed path and needs nothing. After: the count (places with an ordinary tag change from a daily file) is one more count of the geography part of the places summary, built by the one definition changed_places and read with the rest: the geography read of the 2.0M-place bench country went from 6.3 s to 7 ms, the build from 9.1 s to 12.8 s (about 3.7 s more per update run per country), identical JSON stored and computed. It rides the summary's existing key because osm_tag_changes is written by the daily apply only, in the transaction that moves diff_sequence (a test pins the sole writer); a summary built before the change rows existed is counted now, never read as zero; a country with no change file stores 0 and still shows none with its reason. The faster-looking distinct-first form (3.4 s on a one-country bench) was not used: it scans every country's change rows. RULE_REVISION 2 makes every stored summary stale once. No new strings, no new traffic, no schema change.
